scope: Production Next build against synthetic backend contract fixture; not deployed Spring/PostgreSQL or email/OCR provider E2E
checks: registration creates an account without treating its response as a login
reset request shows the account-neutral server response
password reset removes the fragment and sends the token once in the confirm body
document review initializes extracted draft values and uses the protected original URL
vendor-only draft correction preserves OCR category and document type and does not confirm financial data
document contribution requires explicit review, confirms once, and stays confirmed after reload
saved-month Zakat sends unknown declarations as null and renders incomplete results without inventing zero
changing Zakat inputs clears stale results and manual blank balances remain unknown
invalid MFA code preserves the challenge, shows feedback, and allows a subsequent valid code
additional flows have no browser exceptions, CSP violations or hydration errors
